notes: Primary authority is RMCD (SST). Corporate income tax and withholding are administered by the Inland Revenue Board of Malaysia (LHDN / IRBM, https://www.hasil.gov.my) and are cited to LHDN sources. Sales tax and service tax are two separate tax ids; SST is not an input-credit VAT. Starter pack, not a filing position. Reviewed on 2026-11-13.

semantic_mappings.rule: Use for taxable services that take the general service-tax rate (6% through 29 February 2024, 8% from 1 March 2024), other than First Schedule services, credit-card specific charges, and the rental-or-leasing treatment.
Use for taxable services listed in the First Schedule that remain at 6% after 1 March 2024 (F&B, telecoms, parking, logistics, and from 1 July 2025 the expanded First Schedule).
Use for the RM25 per card per year service tax on principal or supplementary credit or charge cards under the Second Schedule.
Use for rental or leasing services: statutory 8% from 1 July 2025, then 8% statutory with a 6% effective charge from 1 January 2026 under DCP 2/2025. Do not map this path to reduced.
Use for taxable goods that take the general 10% sales-tax rate under P.U.(A) 170/2025.
Use for taxable goods in the First Schedule of P.U.(A) 170/2025, charged at 5%.
Use for the 24% corporate income tax that applies from YA 2016, other than companies on the MSME tier schedule.
Use for resident Malaysian-incorporated companies that meet the Sch 1 para 2A/2B SME conditions, on the 15% / 17% / 24% YA 2023+ schedule.
Use for withholding on interest paid to a non-resident under s 109.
Use for withholding on royalties paid to a non-resident under s 109.
Use for withholding on special classes of income under s 4A / s 109B (technical or management services, movable-property use or rental, and similar).
Use for withholding on payments to a non-resident public entertainer under s 109A.
Use for withholding on income under s 4(f) / s 109F.

treatments.name: MSME / SME corporate income tax tiers

rate.notes: ITA 1967 Sch 1 para 2A, as stated for YA 2023–2024 on the LHDN company-rate page. Conditions: resident and incorporated in Malaysia; ordinary paid-up capital not more than RM2.5 million at the start of the basis period; gross business income not more than RM50 million. Paragraph 2B excludes the schedule where, at the start of the basis period, a related company (ordinary capital above RM2.5 million) owns more than 50% of this company (2B(a)), this company owns more than 50% of that related company (2B(b)), or another company directly or indirectly owns more than 50% of both this company and that related company (2B(c); neither of those two companies needs to own the other). Paragraph 2B(d) also excludes the schedule if more than 20% of paid-up capital is owned by foreign-incorporated companies or non-citizen individuals. The exact YA from which para 2B(d) applies was not pinned in the source research (check Finance Act 2023 before relying on that exclusion date).
